preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketingWallet() to set marketing wallet to attacker's address. Then trigger swapAndLiquify mechanism by transferring tokens to contract (or wait for fees to accumulate) to send BNB to the attacker-controlled marketing wallet. Alternatively, use excludeFromFee() to bypass transaction limits and fees, then transfer large amounts of tokens to drain value.
